description: List or fetch integrity-verified dependency/file artifacts through the trusted Runtime downloader. Fetch requires download approval or a matching network prefix except in dangerous mode. Catalog eligibility still requires an initial lockfile or user-owned catalogue; model input cannot provide URLs or headers. List makes no network request.

propertyDescriptions.action: list approved IDs or fetch one ID
propertyDescriptions.artifactId: An ID from list, required for fetch

guidance: Main-agent Code only. Files are integrity-checked and staged under vendor/downloads. Use offline installation, disable lifecycle scripts by default, and run necessary build scripts only offline. Missing approval is not permission to use curl, a browser, a proxy, or another download mechanism. Do not alter a lockfile to manufacture download authority.
